Mauvoo asu maikiithwa ni munene wa trafik wa Taita Taveta Michael Mureithi ula wasya kana mbanga isu yeethiwa itina wa matatu ya andu 14 itatie ku-overtake ngali na yakongana na iloli.

translation:
Monday: Seven people died and fifteen were seriously injured in an accident involving a vehicle and a lorry on the Dar es Salaam road near the Ndara junction in Taita Taveta County towards Mombasa while coming from Voi town.
The incident was confirmed by the Taita Taveta traffic commander Michael Mureithi who said the accident involved a matatu carrying fourteen passengers which tried to overtake another vehicle and collided with a lorry.
Those who died in the matatu were among twenty-two people the matatu was carrying, according to Mr. Mureithi.
Mureithi added that the cause of the accident was speeding and reckless driving.

Ngavana wa kaunti ya Kitui Muwandu Charity Ngilu niwenda makanisa mekonie kunyaiikya maumanyisyo yiulu wa utongoi museo na nzia ila enenthi mailite kwikonia nasyo kukilya ukwati na kukitana na ukya kitui.
Ngilu aneena ndeto ii kavindani kala eitambukite ikanisani ya ACK Diocese ya Kitui musyini wa Kitui uthaithi ula ingi wiivikitwe ni Arc-Bishop munene wa ikanisa yiu Kenya Jackson Ole Sapit vala waweta ta undu wa lato ikanisa yikakwatiania na Serikali ya kaunti kuthukumithya woni woo eli miaka 10 nundu nikyo kyeni kya maendeeo, utongoi, ukwati mutwikanu wa Kitui.
Nake Arc-Bishop Ole Sapit aineena niwaweta kana Vena vata wa akenya onthe kwikonia mboyani ona ila maundu meeta nikenda muuo, mumo na uathimo itatwikana.

translation:
The Governor of Kitui County, Charity Ngilu, intends to visit churches across the county to seek blessings for good governance and development, as well as to discuss issues of marriage and meet with the people of Kitui.
Ngilu said this yesterday while attending a service at the ACK Diocese of Kitui in Kitui town, an event which was largely led by Archbishop Jackson Ole Sapit of the Church of Kenya, where they discussed the issue of the church working with the county government to implement projects over the next ten years, which is key to progress, governance, and the welfare of the people of Kitui.
Archbishop Ole Sapit said he welcomes anyone who wants to come forward, but important matters involve spirit, life, and faith intertwined.

Saulo nĩwe watwĩkie mũsumbĩ wa mbee wa Isilaeli. Ĩndĩ Yeova nĩwamũleile, na Ndaviti anyuvwa atw'ĩke mũsumbĩ vandũ vake. Nĩtũkwona maũndũ maingĩ ĩũlũ wa Ndaviti. E mwanake, nĩwokitie na ĩmũndũ ĩnene yeetawa Ngoliathu. Ĩtina nĩwatolokile akĩa Mũsumbĩ wĩ kĩwĩu Saulo. Avikaili mũndũ mũka mũmbe nesa niwamũsiĩĩie ndakeke ũndũ wa ũtumanu.
Na ĩtina wa ũu, nĩtũkwĩmanyĩsya maũndũ maingĩ ĩũlũ wa Solomoni mwana wa Ndaviti, ũla wasumbĩkie Isilaeli ĩtina wa Ndaviti. Asumbĩ atatũ ma mbee ma Isilaeli masumbĩkie myaka 40 kĩla ũmwe. Ĩtina wa kĩkw'ũ kya Solomoni, Isilaeli nĩyatilĩkanile yatw'ĩka mosumbĩ elĩ, ũsumbĩ wa ĩũlũ na wa ĩtheo.
Ũsumbĩ wa ĩũlũ wa mbaĩ 10 wekalile myaka 257 mbee wa kwanangwa nĩ Asuli. Na ĩndĩ myaka 133 ĩtina, ũsumbĩ wa ĩtheo wa mbaĩ ilĩ o naw'o waanangwa. Ĩvinda yĩu Aisilaeli nĩmataviwe matwawa Mbaviloni. Kwoou Kĩlungu kya KANA kĩeleetye isitoli ya myaka 510, ĩvindanĩ yĩla tũkwona maũndũ maingĩ maũsanzamũkya.

translation:
Saul was the first king of Israel. God chose him, and David pleased Him and became king over his people. We will see many things about the reign of David. And he fought with a giant named Goliath. Then he proved himself worthy to be king when he defeated Saul. He was a brave man who always trusted in his strength.
And now, we will see many things about Solomon, son of David, who reigned over Israel during the reign of David. He ruled the Israelites for forty years each. During the reign of Solomon, Israel prospered and had peace and prosperity.
The reign of the kingdom lasted 257 years until it was conquered by Assyria. And after 133 years, the spiritual kingdom also fell. The people of Israel were taken captive to Babylon. The seventy years of captivity brought an end to the fifty-year cycle, so we will see more important events.

translation:
Let us be zealous in our ministry, even though some people may oppose us and cause trouble like those who persecuted the Christians in Macedonia. We should strengthen ourselves spiritually and courageously speak God's Word, and we should help others to strengthen themselves.
But if someone opposes us and does not want to listen, we should try to reason with him kindly, showing him what the Bible teaches. (1 Thessalonians 3:15) Let us also remember that some people may reject our message. (Matthew 10:14) We need to discern whether they are rejecting us personally or simply disagreeing with the truth, so that we can continue to preach to them. And sometimes people may be troubled because of their own problems or past experiences, and this may make it difficult for them to understand what the Bible says. That is why we need to be patient and compassionate when speaking to people about the good news.
For example, a person might be upset because he has been hurt by others, and he may feel reluctant to trust anyone. In such cases, we should show him kindness and give him an opportunity to express his feelings, so that he can begin to heal and open up to us. And we should realize that some people may have been deeply affected by false teachings or harmful events, and this may prevent them from understanding the Bible clearly. This is why it is important for us to be diligent in studying the Bible and applying its principles. Therefore, we should always be ready to show compassion to as many people as possible.

Mose atongoeisye Aisilaeli kuma ũkombonĩ Misili nginya Kĩĩmanĩ kya Sinaĩ, vala Ngai wamanengeie mĩao yake. Ĩtina, Mose nĩwatũmie aũme 12 makathiane nthĩ ya Kanaani. Ĩndĩ 10 katĩ wa mo matũnga livoti nthũku. Nĩmatumie andũ menda kũsyoka Misili. Na nũndũ wa kwĩthĩwa mate na mũĩkĩĩo, Ngai nĩwasilĩile Aisilaeli kwanganga weũnĩ myaka 40.
Ĩtina vyũ, Yosua nĩwanyuviwe atongoesye Aisilaeli malike nthĩ ya Kanaani. Na nĩ kana amatetheesye mose ĩ nthĩ, Yeova nĩweekie syama. Nĩwaũngamisye kĩw'ũ kya Ũsĩ wa Yolotani, avalũkya ũkũta wa Yeliko mbu, na aũngamya syũa mũthenya mũima. Ĩtina wa myaka thanthatũ, nthĩ nĩyoosiwe kuma kwa Akanaani.
Kwa myaka 356 Aisilaeli masumbĩkiwe nĩ asili, kwambĩĩa na Yosua. Nĩtũkwĩmanyĩsya ĩũlũ wa aingĩ kati wamo, namo nĩ Mbalaka, Ngiteoni, Yevitha, Samusoni, na Samueli. Na ĩngĩ nĩtũũsoma ĩũlũ wa aka ta Laavi, Ndevola, Yaeli, Luthi, Naomi, na Ndelila. Myaka yonthe ya Isitoli ĩla yĩeleetw'e nthĩnĩ wa Kĩlungu kya KATATŨ nĩ 396.

translation:
Moses led the Israelites from Egypt through the Red Sea towards Mount Sinai, where God established His covenant with them. Then, Moses sent twelve scouts to explore the land of Canaan. Ten of them brought back a discouraging report. He sent men to rebel against Egypt. And because of their disbelief and complaining, God made the Israelites wander in the wilderness for 40 years.
Later on, Joshua was commissioned to lead the Israelites into the land of Canaan. And although he completed everything Moses had started, the Lord showed favor. I reminded them of the crossing of the Jordan River, just like the fall of Jericho's walls, and I reminded them of the great miracle. After thirty-five years, the land was inherited by the Canaanites.
For 356 years the Israelites were oppressed by foreigners, including Joshua. We remember many leaders among them, such as Balaam, Gideon, Deborah, Samson, and Samuel. And also we read about people like Levi, Ruth, Jael, Boaz, Naomi, and Delilah. The entire period of Israel's history until the captivity of BABYLON is 396 years.

Matongoewe ni ngavana wa kaunti ya kitui muwandu Charity Kaluki Ngilu ula wa tuma ukiakisyo wake kwa mitandao ya mauvoo nimaweta kana mututia Nyenze ta mutongoi unaaina kithito kya uthukuma enenthi ma kilio kyake kwa wiananu kuma ila wasakuiwe kwi mwaka wa 1997,2013,2017.
Ngilu aweta tauthukumite na nyenze nthini wa mbunge nene kavindani kala wai minista muveani wa Kiwu na ungithya wa miunda vala amenda enenthi ma kilio kii kwithiwa na umiisyo ivindani yii yumu.
Nake muyumbe wa kiliombunge kya kitui kya kati kauntini ya kitui Makali Mulu vamwe na muyumbe wa kitui kya itheo Racheal kaki Nyamai onamo mainatiwa itina kutuma ngethi syoo sya ukiakisyo maiweta kana kilio kii ta kyoosya ndongoi inaisi wia wayo wa kuthukuma enenthi kwa wailu.
Vaa ni ovamwe na MCA kauta kuma isio kivathukanio kuma kauntini ya kitui.

translation:
The death of former Kitui County MP Francis Nyenze has been received with sadness and shock by residents of Kitui town and beyond, with leaders describing him as a dedicated leader who served the people of Kitui County with diligence.
Nyenze's widow, Charity Kaluki Ngilu, expressed her grief through social media platforms, praising her late husband as a hardworking man who overcame numerous challenges throughout his life, including losing elections in 1997, 2013, and 2017.
Ngilu recalled her partnership with Nyenze during his time as an MP and later as Minister for Water and Irrigation, highlighting his commitment to addressing the needs of the people.
Kitui Central MP Makali Mulu and Kitui South MP Racheal Kaki Nyamai also joined in mourning Nyenze, praising his dedication to serving the community and his efforts to improve the lives of others.
They were accompanied by MCAs from across Kitui County in expressing their condolences.

Ũndũ Mbivilia yaasya
Mbivilia yonanasya kana Ngai ndaaũmba Ndevili. Ĩndĩ oombie kyũmbe kĩla kyesie kũtw'ĩka Ndevili. Mbivilia yaĩtye ũũ ĩũlũ wa Ngai: "
Wĩa wake nĩ mwĩanĩu; nũndũ nzĩa syake syonthe nĩ ndũngalu: Ngai wa kĩthito na ũte na naĩ, nake nĩ wa w'o na mũlũngalu." (Kũtũngĩlĩlwa Kwa Mĩao 32:3-5) Kwosana na ndeto isu, no twasye kana ĩvinda yĩmwe Satani aĩ mwĩanĩu na mũlũngalu, e ũmwe wa alaĩka ma Ngai.
Ĩvukunĩ ya Yoana 8:44, Yesũ aisye kana Ndevili "
ndaaĩkala nthĩnĩ wa w'o," kwonany'a kana ve ĩvinda Satani waĩ ngalĩ ya ũw'o ate na naĩ.
O na ũu wĩ o vo, mũlaĩka ũla wesie kũtw'ĩka Satani, o ta syũmbe syonthe syĩ kĩlĩko ila Yeova woombĩte, aĩ na ũthasyo wa kwĩka ũla ũseo kana ũla ũthũku. Kwa kũnyuva kũmũvĩnga Ngai na kũkenga asyai maitũ ma mbee, nĩweetw'ĩkĩthisye Satani, syĩtwa yĩla yonanasya "Mũvĩnganisya."—Mwambĩlĩlyo 3:1-5; Ũvuan'yo 12:9

translation:
The Serpent's Deception
The serpent proved to be deceitful toward Eve, when God created heaven. In fact, most people believe everything they are taught about heaven. The serpent misrepresented the truth about God: "
Your God is selfish; all his creatures are slaves: a jealous God and powerful and cruel, he is a tyrant." (Quoted from Psalms 32:3-5) Just like this lie, we have learned that one creature Satan is selfish and tyrannical, and an enemy of God.
According to John 8:44, Jesus said that the Devil "
was a murderer from the beginning," showing that this creature Satan was a liar and also a murderer.
And so it is today, the majority who are taught about Satan, they all believe everything he has to offer except Jehovah who warns us, and he has the power to reveal the truth about him and about the wicked one. By turning away from God and believing the lies of the serpent, we support Satan, whose name means "Adversary."—Genesis 3:1-5; Revelation 12:9

Ĩthĩwa wĩ mũĩ ĩla ũũnenga andũ ala angĩ mavuku, o na ĩla ũũtavany'a kũndũ kũla kwĩ andũ aingĩ. Ũndũ Mbivilia yaasya
Ti ũndũ wa ũsengyo kũkũlya nĩkĩ andũ makusaa, na mũno mũno ĩla twakw'ĩĩwa nĩ mũndũ witũ. Mbivilia yaasya atĩĩ: "Ũmoa wa kĩkw'ũ nĩ naĩ."
Nĩkĩ andũ onthe mekaa naĩ na kũkw'a?
Asyai maitũ ma mbee, Atamu na Eva, makwie nũndũ nĩmamũvĩtĩisye Ngai. (Mwambĩlĩlyo 3:17-19) Kĩkw'ũ nokyo kyaĩ kĩtonya kũmakwata nũndũ wa kũmũvĩtĩsya Ngai, nĩkwĩthĩwa Ngai nĩwe "mbuluti ya thayũ."
Kwĩsĩla kwa Atamu, nzyawa syake syonthe nĩsyalikile naĩnĩ. Mbivilia yaĩtye atĩĩ: "Nũndũ wa mũndũ ũmwe naĩ yalikile kũũ nthĩ, na kĩkw'ũ kwondũ wa naĩ; na kwa ũu kĩkw'ũ kyavikĩa andũ onthe, nĩkwĩthĩwa onthe nĩmeekie naĩ." (Alomi 5:12) Andũ onthe makusaa nũndũ nĩmekaa naĩ.
Ũndũ kĩkw'ũ kĩkavetwa
Ngai nĩwathanĩte ĩvinda yĩla 'ũkamelya kĩkw'ũ tene na tene.' (Isaia 25:8) Nĩ kana amine kĩkw'ũ, no nginya ambe kũmina kĩla kĩetae kĩkw'ũ, nakyo nĩ naĩ. Ngai akeeka ũu atũmĩĩte Yesũ Klĩsto, ũla, 'umasya naĩ ya nthĩ.'

translation:
The sin of Adam happened
It is a sin of disobedience to eat when we are forbidden, and always we are tempted by the devil. The Bible says: "The wages of sin is death."
Why then do people die and suffer?
Our first parents, Adam and Eve, disobeyed God. (Genesis 3:17-19) Sin also has the power to make us want to disobey God, making God be called "the father of lies."
Because of Adam, his whole human race was ruined. The Bible states: "Through one man sin entered into the world, and through sin, death; and thus death spread to all men, because all have sinned." (Romans 5:12) All people are born with this sin.
What will happen to sin
God will wipe away tears from all faces. (Isaiah 25:8) I believe in sin, and I pray He may forgive every sin, and it is so. God sent His Son Jesus Christ, who 'takes away the sin of the world.'

Yeova nĩwathanie ateũvĩtya maũndũ ala maĩ mekĩke
"Noai mauumu"
Ametia na Avelisia maĩ ndũĩka sya kwĩkya mauumu, kana maangi, na ũta nĩw'o waĩ mũio woo mũnene wa kaũ. Maseũvasya maangi moo na makamanoa nesa ũkethĩa maĩle kũtonya makalika vyũ
"Ngũmbaũ sya Mbaviloni nĩsyaleile kũkita"
Maandĩko ma Nabonidus Chronicle (Maũndũ ma Mavinda ma Nabonidus) maĩtye atĩĩ: "Ita sya Kulusi syalikile Mbaviloni vate kaũ." Ũu nĩkwonany'a kana vai ita syaamasiĩĩa, na kĩu kyosanĩte vyũ na wathani wa Yelemia
"Mbaviloni ĩkatw'ĩka ivumbu [na] vakeethĩwa vathei tene na tene"
Kwambĩĩa mwaka wa 539 Klĩsto ate mũsyae nguma ya Mbaviloni nĩyambĩĩe kũthela. Alexander Ũla Mũnene avangĩte kũtw'ĩkĩthya Mbaviloni mũsyĩ mũnene wa ũsumbĩ wake ĩndĩ mũvango ũsu ũtaneanĩa akw'a. Ĩvindanĩ ya atũmwa ve Ayuti mekalaa kũu, o na nĩkyo kĩtumi mũtũmwa Vetelo ũwetetwe aithi Mbaviloni. Ĩndĩ kũvikĩĩa myaka ya 300 ũu Klĩsto e mũsyae, ndũa ĩsu yaĩ ĩanzo na ĩtina wa ĩvinda nĩyesie kũla vyũ

translation:
The Trinity Doctrine Explained
Many Christians believe that God is a Trinity. The Insightful Encyclopaedia Britannica states: "
The doctrine of the Trinity or Trinitarianism has been a source of controversy among Christians… This teaching developed over centuries, and some found it difficult to understand."
This is why many people think of God as being a Trinity. Consider the following scriptures:
"Jehovah our God is Jehovah the One."—Deuteronomy 6:4.
"Your name is Jehovah, O Most High, O Sovereign of all the earth."—Psalm 83:18.
"And this means everlasting life, their knowing you, the only true God, and Jesus Christ whom you sent forth."—John 17:3
"God is one."—Galatians 3:20.
So why do many Christians believe that God is a Trinity?

Ngai akasilĩla ilaalai.' (Aevelania 13:4) Ndeto ya Kĩkiliki ĩla ĩalyũlawa "ũlaalai," nĩ por·neiʹa, na ũndũ ũmwe ndeto ĩsu yonanasya nĩ andũ matatwaanĩte kũkoma ĩmwe. Kwoou nĩ ũndũ ũtamwendeeasya Ngai andũ matatwaanĩte kwĩkalany'a o na ethĩwa me na mũvango wa kwĩsa kũtwaana.
Nao nata ethĩwa nĩmendanĩte mũno? Ngai endaa asu mendanĩte mambe kũtwaana nĩ kana methĩwe matonya kũkoma ĩmwe. Nĩ Ngai watũmbĩe na ũtonyi wa kwendana. O na ndaĩa yake ĩla nene nĩ wendo. (1 Yoana 4:8) Kwoou e na kĩtumi kĩseo kya kwasya kana andũ maĩle kũkoma ĩmwe o nthĩnĩ wa mũtwaano.

translation:
The Bible says this:
"God will put adultery on trial." (Hebrews 13:4) The Greek word rendered "adultery" is por·neiʹa, and another scripture shows that it involves people who are disloyal to one another. Truly, it is something God detests—people who are disloyal and who disregard his law regarding marital faithfulness.
So why is loyalty important? God wants us to be loyal to one another, even when we face small temptations to be disloyal. He gives us his spirit to help us cope. And his love is great. (1 John 4:8) Truly, he uses his power to help people remain faithful despite the pressure from an unfaithful mate.

translation:
Kitui, September 18th, 2017
The Speaker of the Kitui County Assembly George Mutua reportedly met secretly to discuss issues with the Governor of Kitui County Charity Kaluki Ngilu.
Mutua said this meeting took place at the governor's office where the Speaker was accompanied by the assembly clerk Elijah Mutambuki, and every member attended one session.
Mutua and Mutambuki have informed the governor about the assembly's concerns regarding her reluctance to work with the Speaker Mutua and members in implementing her development plans for the county which are expected to take five years.

Venki wa nthi yoonthe kutetheesya Kenya kuukitana na ndithya sya Ngie
Venki wa nthi yoonthe niwavitukithya silingi bilion 4 na milion 600 kwa nthi ya Kenya, ilovia ila nisya muradi wa kutetheesya Kenya kuukitana na ndithya sya ngie.
Kwa ivinda yambee ungu wa miaka 70, nthi ya Kenya nikunikite vanene kumana na kumbuka kwa ngie ila sietete wanangiko munene.
Ngie isu ila inaminie kukilanilya vaa Kenya kuma nthi mutui ya Ethiopia na Somalia mwaini wa December mwaka muvitu, yu inyaiikite kauntini 28.
Kuatiania na ukunikili ula wikiwe wonanisye kana,ene nthi milion 3 vaa nthi ya Kenya nimatonya kwithwa na nzaani nene kumana na kuvithukiwa ni ngie isu.

translation:
The government of all countries supports Kenya's meeting with the challenges of drought.
The government of all countries has allocated approximately 4 billion and 600 million shillings to the country of Kenya, however, this is not enough support for Kenya to meet the challenges of drought.
For over 70 years, the country of Kenya has been greatly affected and remembers the droughts but does not have significant solutions.
Drought currently threatens to displace Kenyans to neighboring countries such as Ethiopia and Somalia around December this year, affecting about 28 counties.
In addition to the worsening situation reported recently, 3 million people in the country of Kenya may be severely affected and displaced by the current drought.

text:
Andu 9 nimaikiithw'a kukwatwa ni covid-19 vala yu ni 25 onthe
Ene nthi 9 nimo maikiithw'a umunthi kwithiwa na tulinyu twa ikua ya corona vaa Kenya vala namba ya ala mena uwau usu yaambata nginya 25.
Aineena na aandiki ma mauvoo umunthi , minister wa uima wa mwii Mutahi Kagwe niwasya kana andu asu 25 maumite kaunti 4 ila ni Ilovi, Mombasa , Kilifi na Kwale.
Ona ou wiovo Kagwe niwaumbula kana kati wa ene nthi asu 9 maikiithw'a kukwatwa ni uwau usu umunthi ,7 ni aakenya na 2 nima nthi sya nza.
Ingi Kagwe niwasya mivea kivathukanio niyiendeeye kumanthana na andu 745 ala manathengeaniiye na asu mena tulinyu tu.
license: ODC-By-1.0 (dataset); source text subject to Common Crawl Terms of Use
translation:
Nine people have been confirmed infected with covid-19 today which brings the total to 25.
Of these nine people, eight were found to be infected through contact tracing with previous cases of coronavirus in Kenya bringing the total number of those infected so far to 25.
The Minister of Health Mutahi Kagwe said that 25 more people have been identified in four counties namely Illovu, Mombasa, Kilifi and Kwale.
Adding his voice Kagwe announced that out of these nine people confirmed infected with the disease, seven are Kenyans and two are from neighboring countries.
Kagwe further stated that investigations are ongoing to determine who they came into contact with among the 745 people who had traveled with them.

translation:

Consumers will continue to pay the same price for kerosene while gasoline and diesel prices have increased by two shillings and sixty-seven cents, and two shillings and thirteen cents respectively. This is according to the Energy Regulatory Commission ERC review of fuel prices.
According to the latest prices, a liter of petrol and diesel has increased by two shillings and sixty-seven cents, and two shillings and thirteen cents respectively, while kerosene remains at one shilling and twenty-six cents.

Echesa ekiiwe mbini ni maovisaa ma kikosi kimwanya kya kuukitana na umaamai aikonanw'a na kukonanw'a na viasala ya makendo ya mavuti ila ukukonanw'a kutwaaisya na ene nthi ma nthi ingi.
Mauvoo measya kana Echesa anaina muvango na ene nthi ma nthi sya nza ala manavaniiwe kuuwa miio ya itaa sya jeshi kwa kimanza kya silingi bilion 39.

translation:
The Minister of Sports Echesa was summoned to answer questions at the DCI
Reports from sources close to investigating the country's situation at the DCI, indicate he was questioned about allegations against former Sports Minister Rashid Echesa, who was arrested yesterday at his home in the Milimani area of Illovo.
Echesa was arrested on reports from intelligence forces regarding involvement with people suspected of being involved in international fraud and dealings with foreign governments, but the investigations are said to be related to several countries.
Further reports state that Echesa faces charges in several countries and is accused of embezzling funds amounting to approximately 39 billion shillings.
Further reports state that the current Minister of Sports is also facing accusations of receiving 11 million shillings as a bribe.

translation:
The incident involving stolen avocados occurred at Kakuzi Ngilelya in Murang'a county.
Police from Kakuzi location in Ngilelya, Murang'a county, have arrested six suspects following an investigation into the theft of avocados from a farm, and it is alleged they were found with stolen goods, while others escaped.
This is according to information shared by the County Police Commander for Murang'a, Josephat Kinyua.
The operation lasted seven days, and the vehicle belonging to the area Chief of Ngilelya location was used to transport the suspects to various places where similar incidents had been reported, and items recovered from the vehicle included fertilizers and harvested avocados.

text:
Ũndũ Mbivilia yaasya
Mũmbi witũ nĩwaumisye mĩao ya kũtongoesya mũtwaano o na silikalĩ sya andũ itaaumya mwĩao o na ũmwe. Ĩvuku ya mbee ya Mbivilia yĩtwĩĩte atĩĩ: "
Mũndũ mũũme akatia ĩthe na nyinyia, na akalũman'ya na mũka wake: nao makeethĩwa mwĩĩ ũmwe." (Mwambĩlĩlyo 2:24) Kwosana na ĩvuku yĩtawa Vine's Expository Dictionary of Biblical Words, ndeto ya Kĩevelania ĩla yĩalyũlawa mũka "
yonanasya mũndũ mũka." Yesũ nĩwoonanisye ũu ĩla waisye ala maĩle kũtwaana nĩ "
mũndũ mũũme na mũndũ mũka."—Mathayo 19:4.
Kwoou Ngai endaa mũtwaano wĩthĩwe ngwatanĩo ya kũtũaa katĩ wa mũndũ mũũme na mũndũ mũka. Mũndũũme na mũndũ mũka moombiwe nĩ kana matetheanĩsye na mayĩanĩsya mavata ma kĩla ũmwe ma ngoonĩ, wendi wa mũndũũme kũkoma na mũndũ mũka, na vata wa kwĩthĩwa na syana.

translation:
The Bible's View on Marriage
Our Creator has made marriage a bond between one man and one woman to enjoy companionship and procreate. The Bible says: "A man will leave his father and mother and he will stick to his wife, and they will become one flesh." (Genesis 2:24) As explained in Vine's Expository Dictionary of Biblical Words, the Hebrew word used here for "wife"
literally means "a woman belonging to a man." Jesus emphasized this when he spoke about marriage being "one man and one woman."—Matthew 19:4.
God instituted marriage as a union between one man and one woman. A husband and wife should love and cherish each other, sharing their joys and sorrows, the husband taking the lead and the wife supporting him, and both enjoying intimacy.

text:

And I visited the place called Ngie which is located in Utuku near Katanga and Mbusyani, but not the sub-location of Katanga, the location of Kola in Masaku county.
This land which has been disputed for a long time, this land does not belong to anyone and we will resolve it, so let us work together to ensure peace and development.

translation:
Two people were injured during an accident at the port of Mombasa.
Two people were injured and six others sustained serious injuries following a collision involving a truck and a ship at the port of Mombasa, resulting from a container falling on them.
The senior director of the port of Mombasa, Rashid Salim, said that the truck involved belonged to a company owned by one person and was loading containers at shed number 7 at the port when it overturned and injured eight people, two of whom were seriously injured, while the other six were taken to Coast General Hospital for treatment.
The two seriously injured individuals have been allowed to return home from the Coast General Hospital.
The port management has expressed its condolences to the families of those affected.

text:
Ũndũ Mbivilia yaasya
Mũandĩki wa Mbivilia weetawa Luka aisye ũũ ĩũlũ wa maũndũ ala waandĩkie ĩũlũ wa thayũ wa Yesũ: '
Nĩnĩĩkuũĩte nesa vala maũndũ asu onthe maumie'—Luka 1:3.
Andũ amwe maasya kana maũndũ ala maandĩkiwe ĩũlũ wa Yesũ ĩvukunĩ ya Mathayo, Maliko, Luka, na Yoana nĩmavĩndũiwe myakanĩ ya 300.
Ĩndĩ ve kĩlungu kĩmwe kya ĩvuku ya Yoana kyakwatĩkanie nthĩ ya Egypt myakanĩ ya 1900 ĩyambĩĩa. Kĩlungu kĩu yu kĩsĩkĩe ta Papyrus Ryland na kiĩtwe nyũmbanĩ ĩmwe yĩtawa John Rylands Library, Manchester, England. Kĩlungu kĩu kĩ na ndeto sya Yoana 18:31-33, 37, 38 o ila syĩ Mbivilianĩ ĩla twĩ nayo ũmũnthĩ.
Kĩlungu kĩu nĩkyo kya tene vyũ kyaakwatĩkana kya Maandĩko ma Kĩkiliki ma Kĩklĩsto. Asomi aingĩ maĩkĩĩaa kana kyaandĩkiwe mwakanĩ wa 125 ĩtina wa Yesũ kũsyawa, o myaka ta 25 ĩtina wa ĩvuku ya Yoana kũandĩkwa. Ndeto ila syĩ kĩlungunĩ kĩu kyakwatĩkanie nĩsyosanĩte kwa vakuvĩ na ndeto sya mĩsoa ĩsu, ila itũmĩĩtwe mathangũnĩ ma mĩtũkĩ.
license: ODC-By-1.0 (dataset); source text subject to Common Crawl Terms of Use
translation:
The Book of Luke
The writer of Luke is called Luke and he wrote a story about things, but he wrote a story about Jesus: '
I will tell you good news about great joy'—Luke 1:3.
Some people say that the stories about Jesus were written by Matthew, Mark, Luke, and John around the year 300.
It has been found one piece of the book of John in Egypt around the year 1900 AD. This piece is made of Papyrus Ryland and is kept in a library called John Rylands Library, Manchester, England. This piece has verses from John 18:31-33, 37, 38 but it is not the whole Bible we have today.
This piece is one of the oldest pieces of Christian Greek Scriptures ever found. Many scholars believe it was written around the year 125 after Jesus died, or about 25 years after the book of John was written. These verses found in this piece agree with what we have in other scriptures, but they are used differently by different people.

Minister wa muvia wa kisomo Proffessa George Maghoha, niwathingiiliila muungamo wake wa vau mbeeni kana,sukulu siuvingwa na amanyiwa ala manavinguiiye nimekuendeeya na kusoma, o na kwithiwa uwau wa ikua ya Corona wioneka wambiisye kwambata ingi.
Magoha ula waneenea sukuluni wa Kereri ngaliko sya Kisii ivindani yila ei ndambuka yakusyisya undu masukulu meanisye matambya ala manenganitwe ni muvia wa uima wa ene nthi, niwaasya vena vinya kwa amanyiwa kuikiithya ula uasa wa kutaanisya mita umwe me masukulu, indi nomaendeeye na kuthingiliila vata usu kwa amanyiwa.

translation:
Magoha schools are reopening
The Minister of Education Professor George Maghoha, has announced his position today, schools are reopening and students have been encouraged to continue learning, and with the emergence of the Corona virus situation seeming to improve considerably.
Magoha said that schools in Kereri area of Kisii county will begin preparations for resuming studies, while observing guidelines issued by the Ministry of Health of this country, he added that they will ensure compliance with the rule of maintaining a meter distance between students, so that they can continue learning safely.

He was placed under quarantine in Mwala county in Masaku while awaiting test results, he has been found with one person from his home, who tested positive for coronavirus 47 times at the Utandithya testing center in Masii, and he also went ahead and infected others in the country.
The head of the test result team under quarantine in Mwala, Danson Kimithi, said today, appealing to people to cooperate and stop spreading the virus and its effects throughout Mwala county.

text:
Mwaki kuvutha Nyumba Mombasa Bombululu
Andu kauta yu tii nimaendee na ukwata uiiti sivitalini kivathukanio kauntini ya Mombasa, vala masembwa itina wa mwaki munene kuvutha ploti imwe ngaliko sya Bombolulu – Nyali kaunti ya Mombasa.
Munene wa volisi kisioni kyu kya Nyali Daniel Masaba niwatavya mbuluti ya mauvoo kana, mwaki usu wambiia ndakika mbuthu mbee wa saa itatu utuku, kuma nyumbani imwe ya ploti isu ya KISWAHILI na kunyaiika kwa mituki nginya nyumbani ila ingi.
Ingi niwaweta kana, atui nimo mavika kwa mituki na mambiisya kwitaana ala meii plotini isu, na mamasembya sivitalini kivathukanio na ingi, matetheanisya na maovisa ma kukitana na mbanga sya myaki kuma silikalini ya kaunti ya Mombasa kuuvosya, indi wavutha mali ya lato munene plotini isu.
Umo wa mwaki usu ndunamanyika,volisi measya ukunikili niwambiia.

translation:
Fire destroys House Mombasa Bombululu
People say there is a fire incident with smoke seen from afar in the vicinity of Mombasa, while reports indicate a large fire destroyed a plot located near Bombolulu – Nyali county of Mombasa.
The head of police station of Nyali Daniel Masaba has confirmed the incident, saying the fire started around 3 am, destroying one house on the said plot of KISWAHILI and spreading to other houses nearby.
More information indicates, they were alerted by screams and sounds of explosions in the area, and residents reported seeing smoke and more fires, causing panic and chaos among people in several locations within Mombasa county, consequently destroying property worth a lot of money on the said plot.
The cause of the fire is unknown, police are investigating to find out.

text:
Maundu ma ukui Makueni
Ngali 121 sya ukui wa ene nthi nisyo iminite kwianiisya mawalanio ala mekwendeka ni silikali matambite usyokea wia wa ukui wa ene nthi, naa nisyo syikwitikilwa kukuaa ene nthi kauntini ya Makueni.
Komishena wa kaunti isu ya Makueni Mohammed Maalim easya kana, kati wa ngali 2,500 ila ithukumilaa kauntini isu ya Makueni, ngali isu 121 nisyo maikiithisye kwithiwa sianiitye miao isu, vala waumya ukanio muvyu kana, mayitikila ngali ona imwe kukuaa ene nthi itaatiiyite miiao ila inenganitwe kumasiiya ene nthi kumana na uwau wa Corona.
Kuvikia yu tii, mbee wa matatu 300 sya ukui niminie kwikiwa mbini kauntini isu ya Makueni,nundu wa kwithiwa isyokie leluni iteanisye miao isu.

translation:
The situation in Makueni County
Currently 121 people are in quarantine across the country, aiming to prevent the spread of the disease which is spreading rapidly through contact, and they are being monitored to ensure they remain in quarantine within Makueni County.
The county commissioner of Makueni County, Mohammed Maalim said that there are approximately 2,500 people who have been isolated in Makueni County, and those 121 people have been tested and found to be negative, however, some individuals refuse to disclose their travel history, making it difficult to trace contacts and combat the spread of Coronavirus.
Up to now, about 300 matatu vehicles from outside the county have been turned away at border points in Makueni County, and the reason given for turning them back is to protect residents.

text:
Mbunge yienda uelesyo iulu wa utumii wa kinandu kya Covid 19.
Mbunge yienda nikana muvia wa kinandu na ula wa uima wa mwi, sitwaiisye ukunikili iulu wa undu kinandu kya COVID-19 kithiitwe kiitumika.
Gilgil MP Martha Wangari easya kana mwene kivila wa kamitii ya mbunge ya uima wa mwii Sabina Chege niwailite kuelesya mbunge na ripoti mbithianu iulu wa undu ilovia isu syithiitwe siitumika kwambiisya iituku yimwe mwei wa 7 mwaka uu.
Soy MP Caleb Kositany nake niwongela kwasya kana mwene kivila wa kamitii ya kinandu na mivango ya silikali Gladys Wanga, o nake niwaile kuelesya iulu wa utumii wa ilovia isu.
Ona uu wivo, Wanga easya kana nivethiitwe na miseleano kumana na moalyuuku ala maneekiwe o mituki nthini wa utongoi wa kamitii isu.

translation:

Gilgil MP Martha Wangari stated that the chairperson of the parliamentary committee on health Sabina Chege invited her to attend parliament and submit a report on the matter of funds that have been misused without being used properly for seven days this year.
Soy MP Caleb Kositany also said that the chairperson of the committee on funds and government accounts Gladys Wanga, who also invited her to attend regarding the misuse of funds.
In this regard, Wanga stated that she was threatened with lawsuits by people who were not happy about the investigations of this committee.

text:
Mathina ma Kiw'u Mombasa Changamwe
Kambuni ya unyaiikya wa kiw'u kauntini ya Mombasa kwa isyitwa Mombasa water and sewerage company, niyaumbula kana mwoo wa kiw'u ula uendee na ukusiiwa isio kivathukanio kauntini isu ya Mombasa na munomuno sub county ya Changamwe kwa kilungu kya mithenya 6 Mivitu, yumanite na kung'ala kwa Nthongo sya kiw'u kyu ila syi kauntini ya Taita Taveta na kaunti ya Kwale.
Kwianana na uvoo ula watumia mivia ya unyaiikya wa mauvoo, Director munene wa kambuni isu Anthony Njaramba eweta kana, kung'ala kwa nthongo sya Kiw'u sya kisio kya Marere kauntini ya kwale na Mzima natural springs ngaliko sya Taita Taveta, takwo kuetete mwoo usu wa kiw'u kwa oyuyu, naa vala ene nthi maendee na uthi miendo miasa kwikwatia kiw'u kya kutumia.
Ingi kambuni isu niyaweta kana, niendee na kwikia mivango ya kwitaana itambya ya ene nthi kwa kwathukisya kiw'u kila kyumaa kunduni kungi kula kutanamba kung'ala, nikana kila mwenee nthi akatwate kiw'u kya kutumia.
license: ODC-By-1.0 (dataset); source text subject to Common Crawl Terms of Use
translation:
Water sources in Mombasa Changamwe
The water supply company in Mombasa County, known as Mombasa Water and Sewerage Company, announces that the water flow will be interrupted and maintained irregularly in Mombasa County and specifically in the Changamwe sub-county for six hours on Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday due to repairs to the main water pipeline which also serves Taita Taveta County and Kwale County.
Addressing the public through the use of media, the Managing Director of the company, Anthony Njaramba said that the repair of the main water pipeline at Marere area in Kwale County and Mzima natural springs in Taita Taveta, will allow for continued water flow, and this interruption will enable further work to be done to improve water supply.
The company further announced that it will continue to monitor water levels throughout the country to ensure adequate water supply, adding that everyone should conserve water for continuous use.

By Robert Mutunga(Mwambua Ngozi)
Ula wai coach kilavu kya Tottenham Hotspur, Mauricio Pochettino niwaasya kana e tayari kusyoka nthini wa ligi ya England na kuendeea kumanyisya kilavu kila kiumunenga wia.
Pochettino akuniwe kalamu ni Spurs mweini wa November mwaka muthelu na ethiitwe ate wiani vandu va myei 6 mivitu.
Aineena na ithangu ya Irish Times, nuwetie kana we evata na ligi ya England nundu niyo nzeo viu nthi yonthe. Pochettino na ula ni musyawa ya nthi ya Argentina atongoesye Tottenham Hotspur nginya finals sya kikombe kya UEFA Champions League mwakani wa 2018/19 vala timu yake yasindiwe ni Liverpool 2-0 kiwanzani kya Metropolitan,musyini wa Madrid nthi ya Spain.

translation:
May 23rd, 2020
By Robert Mutunga(Mwambua Ngozi)
The former coach of Tottenham Hotspur, Mauricio Pochettino has said that he is ready to return to the English league and continue coaching any team that needs him.
Pochettino was fired from Spurs last November after three and a half years.
According to Irish Times, he stated that he misses the English league very much and wants to return soon. Pochettino who is an Argentine national coached Tottenham Hotspur to the finals of the UEFA Champions League in the 2018/19 season but his team lost to Liverpool 2-0 at the Metropolitan stadium, in the city of Madrid in Spain.
It is also reported that Pochettino has been linked and interviewed by clubs such as Newcastle United, Manchester United and Real Madrid.

By Robert Mutunga(Mwambua Ngozi)
Kilavu kya Newcastle United kina muvango wa kumuandika ula wai director wa mathau wa kilavu kya Paris Saint-Germain Antero Henrique.
Uu ni kuatiania na uungamii mweu wa kilavu kiu, kila kinathooiwe ni itonga imwe kuma nthi ya Saudi Arabia. Maineena ithangu ya Le10Sport ya kuya nthi ya France, atandithya asu ma Saudia nimaisye kana meenda kuete director mweu wa mathau vamwe na kochi .
Makochi ala mamulikitwe tamo meendeka ni vamwe na kochi wa tene wa Newcastle United Rafael Benitez undu umwe na kochi wa tene wa Tottenham Hotspur Mauricio Pochettino.
Henrique ula kavindani kaa ute wiani athukumie ta director wa mathau na kilavu kya FC Porto kya Portugal vandu va myaka 10, mbee wa kuthamiia PSG vala watetheeisye muno kuthooa athauki ma kiwango kya yiulu ta Kylian Mbappe na Neymar .

translation:
May 26th, 2020
By Robert Mutunga(Mwambua Ngozi)
Newcastle United's owners have an intention of writing to the former director of sports of the Paris Saint-Germain club, Antero Henrique.
This is due to the support he has for the club, because everything he does is connected to investments in Saudi Arabia. According to information from Le10Sport from France, Saudi investors want to bring him to be a sports director alongside a coach.
The coaches who have been considered for this move are among the former Newcastle United coach Rafael Benitez and the former Tottenham Hotspur coach Mauricio Pochettino.
Henrique previously served as a director of sports for the FC Porto club of Portugal for 10 years, before joining PSG where he was responsible for signing players at high levels such as Kylian Mbappe and Neymar.

Musyi Fm | Last Updated: August 1, 2020 at 11:35 am

According to information reaching us, the man refused to cooperate and reportedly started packing his fruits, while those present claim he appeared disturbed and agitated before being shot by his colleague.

translation:
May 18th, 2020
By Robert Mutunga (Mwambua Ngozi)
The former head writer of the Cecafa tournament Nicholas Musonye has resigned from his position as the chairman of Kenyan football, ending his tenure which saw him oversee numerous Cecafa tournaments and greatly contribute to the development of football in Kenya.
Musonye, who served diligently and with great passion for the game of FKF locally and internationally, has inspired generations of young people through Fkf's various programs aimed at promoting talent and securing opportunities with Cecafa, an initiative that has significantly improved the standards of football across Kenya.
The veteran, aged 57, worked closely with current FKF president Nick Mwendwa, former FKF leader Sam Nyamweya, his predecessor Twaha Mbarak, former AFC Leopards chairman Alex Ole Magello, Vihiga County governor Moses Akaranga, and prominent sports journalist Omondi Aduda.

text:
Uhuru on Corona Myamulo na Curfew kuma Uni
Ta nzia imwe ya myamulo na mitalatala ila silikali nene yiendeeye na kwosa,Muusumbi Uhuru Kenyatta, iyoo niwatangaasa kana, kwambiiya Uni Wakataano matuku 27, ene nthi ma Kenya maiketikilw'a kumaaluka nza wa nyumba syoo kwambiiya saa umwe wa wiyoo nginya saa kumi na umwe wa wakya, ta nza nzia imwe ya kusiiya kunyaiika kwa uwau wa Ikua ya Corona.
Kenyatta niwasya kana Aakenya ala mathukumaa miveani ya vata ta iseseni sya unyaiikya mauvoo, uiiti, muuo wa nthini, kambuni ya stima Kenya Power kati wa mivea ingi nimo maketikilw'a kwithiwa nza ivindani yiu ya ene nthi kusiiwa kumaaluka nza.
O Kavindani kau,Kati wa maundu amwe ala muusumbi utangaasie kuikiithya ene nthi mainavinyiika muno kumana na kunyaiika kwa uwau usu, yu ene nthi ala makwataa misaala ya silingi 24k na kutheeya maikuiva koti.
Muvia wa kinandu ingi niwaumiw'a mwiao kutheesya ndivi ya koti kuma kilungu kya 16% nginya 14 % kwambiiya ituku yimwe ya mwai usu twathi wa 4.
Ingi Musumbi Kenyatta easya kana,Musaala wake na wa Musumbi munini syitilwa kilungu kya 80% nayo ya maminister yitilwa kilungu kya 30% ta nzia imwe ya kumantha ilovia sya kuukitana na uwau usu wa Corona.

translation:

Through one way of regulations and discussions but a serious matter continues with loss, President Uhuru Kenyatta, this is what I announce, regarding the ten universities for 27 days, throughout the country of Kenya restricted to staying at home so that from one hour in the afternoon until eleven hours at night, through another way of preventing the spread of the Coronavirus disease.
Kenyatta announced that Kenyans should avoid gatherings of people in places prone to infection, including churches, funerals, companies like Kenya Power and many others were restricted to remaining within their homes to prevent spreading outside.
Regarding some things, the president announced reducing taxes across the country to help with the spread of the disease, meaning the country will lose revenue equivalent to 24 billion shillings and postpone paying debts.
Many sectors have been affected leading to a reduction of income tax from 16% to 14% meaning one day's income has decreased to 4%.
Furthermore, President Kenyatta said his salary and that of the Deputy President will be reduced by 80% and that of ministers by 30% as a way of supporting the fight against the Coronavirus disease.

Magoha postpones Form Four exam dates
The Kenya National Examinations Council has announced the postponement of the Form 4 exams due to ongoing rains, Education Cabinet Secretary George Magoha said, adding that the delay will allow students to prepare adequately and ensure the integrity of the tests.

The Books of the Bible
Many people may wonder why there are 66 books in the Bible. The Bible consists of 66 books that were written down. Some books are identified by titles such as "
the book of Nehemiah," "the prophecy of Isaiah," and "
the book of Joel, son of Pethuel."—Nehemiah 1:1; Isaiah 1:1; Joel 1:1.
Many writers of the Bible indicated that the things they wrote came from God, the Sovereign Lord, Jehovah, and that he inspired them. At times, those who wrote the Hebrew Scriptures would write hundreds of words: "
This is what Jehovah has said." (Amos 1:3; Micah 2:3; Nahum 1:12) God used angels to speak to some of the Bible writers.—Zechariah 1:7, 9.
The Bible was written by about 40 men over a period of 1,600 years. Some men wrote only one book of the Bible. The Bible is a collection of 66 books. It contains 39 books of the Hebrew Scriptures, often called the Old Testament, and 27 books of the Christian Greek Scriptures, often called the New Testament.

Captain wa Harambee Stars Victor Wanyama niwaumbula kana nzama ya Football Kenya Federation (FKF) niyoosie kimanza kya Ksh.12 million kuma kwi Ksh. 50 million ila timu isu yanengwete ta muthinzio.

"FKF yaina muvango wa kwosa sh15 million na yinengame sh35 million kwa athauki maane syo lakini nalea ," uneeni wake Wanyama aineena na kisese kya MGTV.
Ilovia isu Ksh. 50 million syathitwe athauki vamwe na technical bench ya timu wa Stars, vala oingi waelesya kana we vayingwa ivinda waaikala nthi na maovisa ma FKF akaumya utwio kana kukwata mbau itambya ya nzama isu undu yaile kuiva athauki.

May 21st, 2020
By Robert Mutunga(Mwambua Ngozi)
The captain of Harambee Stars, Victor Wanyama, has accused the Football Kenya Federation (FKF) of only giving a starting amount of Ksh.12 million out of a promised Ksh. 50 million, yet the team still hasn't been fully compensated.
The Stars were reportedly unpaid because the government took the tickets for traveling expenses during the 2019 Afcon tournament in Egypt.
"FKF had a budget of over sh15 million and received sh35 million for travel expenses, however, nothing was given," Wanyama said in an interview with MGTV.
Out of the Ksh. 50 million, some was paid to other players and the technical bench of the Stars team, but many are unsure if they were paid everything owed to them while the FKF management remains silent on whether they will take responsibility for this issue.

translation:
May 22nd, 2020
By Robert Mutunga(Mwambua Ngozi)
Harambee Stars goalkeeper Faruk Shikhalo has revealed that he almost lost his salary along with other allowances while the team was being poorly treated by the FKF during the 2019 Afcon tournament in Egypt.
Shikhalo, who was Kenya's second choice goalkeeper during the tournament, has revealed that each player under coach Sebastien Migne was supposed to receive KSh.750,000.
Speaking to Goal.Com, Shikhalo said he decided to remain silent about the issue because he did not want to cause problems or create conflict, but he added that he has now spoken openly about it to honor his conscience.
Following pressure from the public and the media regarding the Afcon allowances and Kenya's poor performance against Tanzania, Shikhalo says he finally received his dues, but others have not yet been paid their rightful share. Shikhalo currently plays for Yanga FC in Tanzania.

text:
11th May 2020
By Robert Mutunga(Mwambua Ngozi)
Kocha wa tene wa Harambee Stars Adel Amrouche niwaasya kana David Owino ni umwe Kati wa madefender ala aseo viu vaa Africa.
Owino na ula uthaukiaa Zesco United, kuya nthi ya Zambia, ethiitwe ena uthauki wa kwendeesya kuma ivindani ila wathaukiaa Gor Mahia.
Owino ai nthini wa kikosi kya Kenya kila kyanengie Nigeria ivinda yeetu mwakani wa 2013 musyini wa Calabar vala Stars maumie draw ya 1-1 na Super Eagles,mathauni ma kusyima tikiti wa World Cup 2014.
Amrouche enenaa na mutandao wa Goal kavindani kala meumukulasya yiulu wa muthauki usu na ula wina ukuu wa myaka 32. O ingi Amrouche niwongela kwasya ithauni yoo na Nigeria, Owino niwamunengie muthauki Victor Moses, ivindani yiu aithaukia kilavu kya Chelsea ivinda yumu kiwanzani, vala utaamunenga yanya ya kwonanyia utuika wake vakuvi na goal ya Harambee Stars.
Kuya Zambia, Owino nusindite ikombe 4 sya ligi ya nthi isu, 2 sya Absa Cups, na ingi 2 sya Charity Shields. Mwaka wa 2016, niwatetheeissye Zesco kuvika nthini wa semi-finals sya CAF Champions League.

translation:
May 11th, 2020
By Robert Mutunga(Mwambua Ngozi)
Harambee Stars team coach Adel Amrouche has stated that David Owino is among the best defenders currently in Africa.
Owino, who currently plays for Zesco United, from the country of Zambia, was previously playing for Gor Mahia.
Owino was in the Kenyan squad during the match against Nigeria in 2013 in Calabar where Stars drew 1-1 with the Super Eagles, hoping to secure tickets for the 2014 World Cup.
Amrouche told Goal's website that he remembers Owino very well because of his excellent performance against Nigeria, where Owino marked player Victor Moses, who at the time played for Chelsea, preventing him from getting opportunities to score against Harambee Stars.
In Zambia, Owino has won 4 league titles, 2 Absa Cups, and another 2 Charity Shields. In 2016, he helped Zesco reach the semi-finals of the CAF Champions League.

Uwau wa Corona kuendeeya kwambata Kenya
Minister wa muvia wa uima wa ene nthi Mutahi Kagwe, niwaumya ukanio muvyu kwa ene nthi mevetangane na mituo ya kwenda kuleelya myamulo ila inenganitwe ni silikali ya kwisiania na uwau wa Corona.
Kagwe aneena ndeto isu umunthi muthenya, yila ukunenganae report sya muvia wa uima wa ene nthi, yiulu wa Uwau wa Corona.
Kuatiania na minister Kagwe, Andu 685 umunthi nimaikiithwa kukwatwa ni uwau wa Corona,itina wa ithimo sya uwau usu, ila syatwaiiw'a kwa andu ngili 4,912.
Andu angi 105 umunthi nimaikiithwa kuvoa vyu uwau wa Corona.
O na uu wiovo,Kagwe easya andu 28 vaa Kenya yu tii me nyumbani ila syakuthinikia andu ala methiawa me avinyiiye muno ni uwau sivitalini syi kivathukanio,mawaite uwau wa Corona.
Andu angi 7 nimaikiithwa kutiwa ni thayu umunthi maikonanwa na kwithiwa mewaite uwau wa Corona.
Kuvikia yu tii andu 832 nimo maminite kuikiithwa kutiwa ni thayu kuma yila uwau wa Corona wavikie vaa Kenya.

translation:
The case of Coronavirus continues to rise in Kenya
The Minister of Health Cabinet Secretary Mutahi Kagwe, has expressed concern about the increasing cases in the country interacting with people going to celebrate holidays but it should be controlled by strict adherence to the protocols of dealing with the Coronavirus.
Kagwe said today that according to the Ministry of Health reports, the situation of the Coronavirus is worrying.
According to Minister Kagwe, 685 people have been confirmed to have contracted the Coronavirus today, bringing the total number of cases to date to 4,912.
Another 105 people have been confirmed to have recovered from the Coronavirus.
And moreover, Kagwe urged Kenyans to stay at home but emphasized that people who violate the rules will be arrested because they are putting others at risk of contracting the Coronavirus.
Seven more people were confirmed to be in critical condition in hospitals related to being infected with the Coronavirus.
So far, a total of 832 people have been admitted to hospitals due to being infected with the Coronavirus in Kenya.

translation:
Are there things we can do to have peace of mind?
Indeed, many people are troubled about world events. Do you ever wonder whether people will ever settle their differences peacefully? Alas. Many people find life stressful and full of trouble. May God give us strength to cope with life's problems.—Read 2 Peter 3:13.
God's Kingdom will bring peace of mind to those who love him. People will live safely and happily, and no one will cause them fear.—Read Micah 4:3, 4.
What will move people to live peacefully?
God trains individuals to walk in peaceful ways. If an imperfect person strives to please God, he can be successful. Let us imitate that training under Adam. God sent Jesus to rescue people from sin.—Read Romans 7:21, 24, 25.
By means of his Son, Jesus showed the way to obey God and did good things, always striving to please God under Adam's rule. (Romans 5:19) By obeying Jesus' example, people can enjoy lasting peace of mind and stop causing others trouble—Read Psalm 37:9-11.

8th May 2020
By Robert Mutunga(Mwambua Ngozi)
Kampuni ila itwaiasya ligi ya muvila wa maau vaa Kenya, Kenyan Premier League Limited (KPL) niyiandikiie nzama ya muvila wa maau vaa Africa CAF yiilalamika yiulu wa itambya ya FKF kutangaasa kuthela kwa ligi ya KPL mathau mate mathelu.
Kyumwa kivitu mweene kivila wa FKF, Nick Mwendwa nunatumie mauvoo nthini wa mitandao, vala unawetie kana ligi isu ninathelile na atangaasa Gor Mahia tamo ngumbau sya KPL 2019/20 vala oingi unathakisye ndeve kilavu kya Nairobi City Stars kuthauka nthini wa KPL.
Ona ou wiovo KPL Limited, kwisila kwa ovisa woo munene Jack Oguda nimaminite kuleana na itambya ya Mwendwa mayasya kana veina ivinda yianiie ya kusyaiisya undu maundu me kwikala kumana na uwau wa Covid-19.
KPL Limited measya nimo mena ukumu wa kutangaasa kuthela kwa ligi isu kuatiania na wiwano ula weekie Kati woo na nzama ya FKF nundu nimo matwaiiasya ligi ya muvila wa maau vaa Kenya.
Ngusanisyo ii syumilile vatialite myei 4 kandarasi ya KPL kwithiwa yitwaiisya Ligi isu kuthela vala Mwendwa withiitwe ayasya kana nivatonyeka makalea kwongela kandarasi isu ingi.

May 8th, 2020
By Robert Mutunga(Mwambua Ngozi)
The company, however, will await the decision of the Kenyan Premier League Limited (KPL) regarding the request from the Football Federation of Kenya (FKF) to start the league again after three months.
Because of things within the FKF, Nick Mwendwa has been sending messages on social media, stating that the league is over and declaring Gor Mahia champions of the KPL 2019/20 season, while also congratulating Nairobi City Stars on their promotion to the KPL.
According to sources from KPL Limited, apart from the large amount of money Jack Oguda has spent, they believe Mwendwa's statements are aimed at creating confusion about the situation due to the Covid-19 pandemic.
KPL Limited says it is still waiting for a decision to begin the league again based on the agreement between them and the FKF, which will allow the Kenyan Premier League to continue.
This statement comes after the fourth meeting of the KPL contract, where it was decided that the league would end, but Mwendwa was told he could face legal action regarding this contract.

Nivatonyeka mathau ma kikombe kya African Cup of Nations 2021 na ala mavaniiwe kwithiwa nthi ya Cameroon kwambiia mwei wa January makakuiiwa nundu wa uwau wa Covid-19.
Kuatiania na mauvoo kuma kwa RMC Sports, nzama ya kuungamia muvila wa maau vaa Africa ya CAF, nitonya ikuiisya mathau asu nginya mwaka wa 2022 vala mauvoo asu mavaniiwe kutangaaswa ivinda ite vaasa.
Mauvoo asu nimaendeeie kwasya kana ngewa ila yivo kwa ooyu nikukuiisya mathau asu nginya mwei wa mbee 2022, nundu mwakani ousu now'o mathau ma Kikombe kya World Cup makathaukwa mweini wa 11 kuya Qatar.
Vena mikondo 4 itialitye kwa timu kuthauka ni kana ikwate tikiti wa mathau asu vala walanyo wa kuthauka unavalaanilwe ni uwau wa Corona.
Mathau asu mavaniiwe kuthaukwa kwambiia matuku 9, January nginya February 6, 2021, o undu mathaukiwe mwaka wa 2017. CAF niyasenzisye kalenda kayo nundu myaka ya vau itina mathau asu meethiawa mwaka ula kwi mathau ma World Cup undu ula watumaa timu mbingi sya Africa iteka nesa kumana na athauki kwitha mena minoo mingi.

translation:
May 28th, 2020
By Robert Mutunga(Mwambua Ngozi)
The tournament for the African Cup of Nations 2021 has been postponed and initially scheduled to be held in the country of Cameroon during the month of January has been delayed due to the outbreak of the Covid-19 pandemic.
According to information from RMC Sports, the committee responsible for organizing African tournaments under CAF, may postpone the tournament again until next year 2022 unless the situation improves so that it can start on time as planned.
The tournament may continue as planned or be postponed until February 2022, while this year's World Cup tournament is scheduled for November going to Qatar.
Four venues have already been identified for the teams to qualify, but whether they will get tickets for the tournament depends on how the Coronavirus pandemic unfolds.
The tournament was originally scheduled to take place between January 9th and February 6th, 2021, a schedule which had been set in 2017. CAF has revised its calendar several times over the years to avoid clashing with the World Cup schedule which sends many African teams into a dilemma of having too many games.

By Robert Mutunga(Mwambua Ngozi)
Muthauki wa kiwanzani kati kati wa kilavu Tottenham, o undumwe na timu ya England Dele Alli nukwatie maauumisye kavindani kala uvithukiiwe nyumba kwake masaani ma kuikya muthenyani wa iyoo ni mang'endili eli na ala meikwete tuvyu.

Alli akwatie mauumisye ma uthyu nthini wa kisanga kiu vala ing'ei isu itolokile na saa, masoa na mbete syoonthe sya thaavu. O kavindani kau Kilavu kya Spurs nikiendeeye na utetheesya Alli vala kyaumya witano kwa mundu ula withiwa na mauvoo yiulu wa mang'endili asu akune livoti kwa muvea wa volisi.
Muthauki usu nunenganie musivi wa camera sya CCTV kwi muvea wa volisi vala maendeeye na ukunikili. O ingi nutumie ngethi sya kutunga muvea kwa mashabiki nthini wa mtandao wake wa Twitter.
Kuvikiia vau vai mundu unesya kwikiwa mbini kuatiania na kisanga kiu. Kungi ni kana mweini wa 3, musyi wa muthauki munyanyae wa kilavu kiu kya Spurs Jan Vertonghen,nimavithukiwe na mooyiwa ni mang'endili makwete tuvyu vala muthauki usu wai nthi sya nza mathauni ma Champions League kiko kiu kiyikika.

By Robert Mutunga(Mwambua Ngozi)
The midfielder of the Tottenham club, who plays for the England team Dele Alli has been attacked at his home while trying to protect himself from thieves during the current situation which is difficult and scary.
Thieves broke into Alli's house and stole valuable items worth 24 years of age in the city of London, but they were caught because the English national team does not allow people to move around due to the Coronavirus pandemic. Alli has a child and his brother was also attacked at his home.
Alli was injured in the head during the incident which happened at night, with cuts and bruises all over his body. The thieves of the Spurs club continued to harass Alli until someone who had seen the thieves alerted the police.
The reporter used CCTV footage to help the police investigate and he also shared information on his Twitter account to inform fans.
It seems many people are being attacked due to this situation. Just recently, the defender of the Spurs club Jan Vertonghen, was robbed by thieves who stole valuables, and the reporter said that this incident happened when the team was preparing for the Champions League competition.

Mawendekethyo ma sukulu ivinguwe
vindani yii Uneenania wambiisye yiulu wa undu masukulu meuvinguwa ingi, amwe ma mawendekethyo ala meikwatiwa kuneenaniwa umunthi kikaloni kya nzama ya maminister ni kalenda ka masomo ka mwaka wa 2021 na mwaka wa 2022.
Komitii ila itongoewe ni Dr. Sara Ruto yiendekethya term wa keeli wa masomo mwakani uu, wambiisye wakwambiliilya matuku 5 ma mwai wa 10 mwakani uu, naa amanyiwa ma kilasi kya 8, kilasi kya 4, o undu umwe na amanyiwa ma kilasi kya 7 na form 3 mayamba kunewa mwanya wa kuthi masukulu, nikana masome nginya mwaiini wa desemba, naa masukulu mayamba kuvingwa syumwa 2, mbee wa masukulu kuvinguwa kwa term 3 mwakani usu twathi.
O na uu wiovo, Kalenda ka masomo ka mwaka 2021,keendekethwa kambiisye muthyani wa mwai 4 mwaka twathi, itina wa amanyiwa ma kilasi 8 na ma kya form 4 kuminukilya kwika mutihani woo wa muthya.
Kuatiania na walanio usu,Mutihani wa KCPE wa Mwaka uu,Uvangiiwe kwika matuku 15 ma mwai 3 mwaka usu twathi, naa wathela oou nawo mutihani wa FORM 4 KCSE uyambiisya.
Ingi Komitii isu yiendekethya amanyiwa methiwe maisoma matena ivinda ya kuthyumua kati kati wa Term kana Midterm.
Nake Minister wa muvia wa Kisomo Mutahi kagwe, easya muvia wake naa ula wa Kisomo, niuthukuma syi muamba kuikiithya kwina mivango myailu ya kuikiithya muuo wa amanyiwa masyokethya masukulu.

translation:
School calendars have been revised
the ministry has announced a review of the school calendar, with some revisions made to accommodate the 2021 and 2022 academic years.
This committee, led by Dr. Sara Ruto, announced that the first term will begin on April 25th this year, with classes 8, 4, and 7, as well as Form 3 students, starting school, and exams beginning in early December, with schools closing on December 2nd, continuing the third term of this year.
And again, the 2021 academic calendar was revised to start on May 4th last year, to allow candidates in Class 8 and Form 4 to prepare for their final exam.
In addition, this year's KCPE exam will be administered over 15 days in March this year, and the Form 4 KCSE exam will also begin.
Furthermore, this committee has reviewed midterm breaks during the middle of terms or midterms.
According to Education Cabinet Secretary Mutahi Kagwe, through his ministry and the Department of Education, they are committed to ensuring smooth implementation of the revised school calendar.

text:

Andu 5 nimo maminite kukwatwa maikonanwa na kiko kimwe, vala mundu muka umwe wina ukuu wa myaka 55 unooaiw'e ni andu matesikie mamuvivisya nyumbani nduani ya Kathuma_Kyambuko, ila yi sub location ya Misakwani, location ya Mumbuni kauntini ya Masaku, kumana na ngusanisyo sya itheka.
Ndeto isu syaikiithwa ni ovisaa munene wa muvia wa kisalu ku Masaku Muwandu Rhoda Kanyi.
Esililwa asu me 5 ni andu ma mukonyo woo, vala umwe ni mwanaainya wa kiveti kiu kinooaiw'e.
Mbee wa esililwa asu kuvivya na kuaa mundu muka usu,mewetwa kwitha manambie kumuvithukia muume wake ula wina myaka 65, ula unai na musyini ungi wake ula wi kisioni kya Mtito andei kauntini ya Makueni na kumutia na mauumisye, O tondu Ovisaa kanyi ukuelesya.
Muume wa mundu muka usu unooaiw'e ena mwanae, maendeeye na kukwata uiiti sivitalni munene wa Masaku mena maumiisye manene, ala manakwatie kuma kwa esililwa asu.
Ukunikili no utwaiiwe, itina wa mauvoo kumbuka kana, Mutumia mwene musyi usu na kiveti kyake, manai maneekiwa wia ni esililwa asu kana nimatonya kumowaa, vala manai manaandikithya report isu kiseseni kya Volisi kya Masaku.

translation:
The incident occurred involving a theft at Kathuma Kyambuko Masaku.
Five people have been arrested in connection with the incident, including a woman aged 55 who was found by residents being searched at her home in Kathuma_Kyambuko, specifically in the Misakwani sub-location, Mumbuni location, Masaku county, due to suspicion related to the theft.
This information was confirmed by the senior police officer in charge of Masaku Police Station, Rhoda Kanyi.
There are five suspects involved, including one who is a relative of the victim.
The suspect is accused of assaulting a woman, allegedly causing serious injuries to her husband, who is 65 years old and lives with his other wife in Mtito Andei, Makueni county, and inflicting pain on him, according to Officer Kanyi's statement.
The woman's husband has a child, and they were found possessing a large amount of stolen goods from Masaku, which caused significant losses, but they were apprehended at the suspect's residence.
According to investigations, the motive behind the crime may be revenge; the owner of the house and his family were reportedly targeted because of the suspect, or perhaps to intimidate them, and a report was filed at the Masaku Police Station regarding this matter.

translation:
Members during the session have approved the motion of the members' bill on matters relating to youth affairs in Kenya.
The resolution was tabled in parliament today, with members, especially those supporting President Dr. William Ruto, urging the postponement of the debate on the sports fund bill in this parliament.
The concerns of the members stem from proposals made by the member of parliament for Nambale Sakwa Bunyasi, regarding the welfare of Kenyan youth, supported by the head of state himself.

Andu 4 kutiwa ni thayu Mwanyani Masaku kumana na mbanga ya Lelu
Andu 4 ala mei ngalini nini, nimatiwa ni thayu vau kwa vau umunthi kuituka, itina wa mbanga nthuku ya lelu ila yakonia ngali nini na iloli kisioni kya Mwanyani, leluni wa kuma Masaku kuthi Kitui.
Kuatiania na ovisaa munene wa muvia wa kuthinikia mbanga sya Mituki silikalini ya kaunti ya Masaku David Mwongela,mbanga isu yakitika itina wa dereva wa ngali isu nini ila yiumite Masaku kuthi Kitui kuemwa ni kumilunga, yila ukutaa kuvituka ngali ingi, na indi nivo weethiana na iloli yila yiumite ngaliko sya Kitui, vala syakongana kyongo kwa kyongo.
Komanda wa volisi ku Masaku Issa Mohammud niwataa mateleva matwae ngali kwa ui munene, ta nzia imwe ya kuolanga mbanga ta isu.
Ala mei ilolini namo Makita kutelema kumana na mbanga isu.
license: ODC-By-1.0 (dataset); source text subject to Common Crawl Terms of Use
translation:
Four people were injured when a vehicle belonging to Mwanyani Masaku collided with a lorry from Lelu.
The four victims have no serious injuries, they were treated on the spot and discharged, the wreckage of the lorry remained at the scene until this morning, but it was removed with a crane belonging to Mwanyani, leading to traffic congestion from Masaku to Kitui.
Speaking about the large number of accidents involving lorries along the Mituki route within Machakos County, David Mwongela said the accident occurred due to driver error, but it happened in Masaku heading towards Kitui because of speeding, causing more vehicles to collide, and another vehicle hit a lorry coming from Kitui, resulting in a head-on collision.
Masaku Police Commander Issa Mohammud called for drivers to be careful on the road, as one way to reduce such accidents.
They also reported that a tractor tried to help clear the wreckage.

translation:
Moses Wetangula has been elected speaker of the thirteenth parliament.
Wetangula defeated his competitor for the position of speaker of parliament with 215 votes against Kenneth Marende who received 130 votes, and the member of parliament for Shinyalu constituency congratulated Wetangula on becoming speaker.
Thirty members have expressed their willingness to fill the vacant position which was left after some were appointed to ministerial positions, and anyone who meets the requirements can contest and receive 233 votes, which is two-thirds of the total number of parliamentary seats, and be declared victorious. The vote will take place today and tomorrow.

By Robert Mutunga(Mwambua Ngozi)

Rice ambiiye uthauki wake nthini wa kimanyisyo kya maundu ma mathau kya Chelsea e wa ukuu munini.
O kavindani kau nakyo kilavu kya Newcastle United nikiumuthooa Gareth Bale wa Real Madrid, nthini wa kalenda ka uthauki mwakani wa 2020/21.
Itonga kuma nthi ya Saudi Arabia na ila iminite kuthooa kilavu kiu syina muvango wa kumuandika kochi wa tene wa Tottenham Hotspur Mauricio Pochettino, nikana oselee usukani wa uvundisya timu isu vala oingi maendee kumatha athauki ala mena utuika munene utheelini wa ndulyu.
Bale ena utuika wa kwiana wa ligi ya Epl nundu ai muthauki wa tene wa Tottenham Hotspur atanamba kuthamiia Real Madrid vala utialitye myaka 2 kandarasi yake ithele na kilavu kiu kya Santiago Barnebeu.

text:
15th May 2020
By Robert Mutunga(Mwambua Ngozi)
Umunthi ni myaka 9 kuma ila ngumbau ya Olympic ithauni ya marathon Samuel Kamau Wanjiru watiiwe ni thayu. Wanjiru atiiwe ni thayu matuku 15 May 2011 ena ukuu wa myaka 24 vala wavalukile kuma ngolovani yambee nyumba kwake musyini wa Nyahururu. Wanjiru niwe weekiie record ila yivo kwa ooyu ya 10,000M World Junior mwaka wa 2005 na record ya half marathon mavinda 3.
Wanjiru niwe muthauki wa mbee viu kusinda mitila ya thaavu mathauni ma Olympic ngalikoni ya aume vaa Kenya, vala wasindie mitila ya thaavu kuya Beijing, China mwakani wa 2008. Mathau angi ma marathon ala wasindie ni vamwe na Chicago Marathon 2009 na 2010, London marathon
2009(Gold ) na 2008(Silver).
Mwakani wa 2008 kuya Beijing Olympics asindie ithau yiu itina wa kusemba masaa 2:06:32, vala weekiie historia kusinda marathon ena ukuu munini viu wa myaka 22 kuma mwakani wa 1932.

translation:
May 15th, 2020
By Robert Mutunga(Mwambua Ngozi)
The deceased was 9 years old when the Olympic marathon champion Samuel Kamau Wanjiru died in an accident. Wanjiru died in an accident on May 15th, 2011, at the age of 24 while returning home from a bar in Nyahururu town. Wanjiru held the record but lost it due to injury in the 10,000M World Junior in 2005 and the half marathon record three times.
Wanjiru was the first athlete to win medals in athletics at the Olympic Games representing Kenya, having won medals in athletics going to Beijing, China in 2008. Other marathons he won include the Chicago Marathon 2009 and 2010, London marathon
2009(Gold ) and 2008(Silver).
In 2008 going to the Beijing Olympics he won the race in a time of 2:06:32, holding history winning the marathon at the young age of 22 years since 1932.

text:
Magoha kwasya amanyiwa masuviwe me masukulu Kenya
Silikali niyaumya mwiao kwa Atongoi oonthe ma masukulu, maiye report sya amanyiwa oonthe ala methiawa na mathina kana uwau wa umasumbuaa, ta nzia imwe ya kuthinikiwa kwa mituki vaumila vata.
Minister wa muvia wa kisomo Proffessa George Magoha, aumya mwiao usu yila wavika sukuluni wa musingi wa Olympic ula wi kibera vaa Musyini wa Ilovi, aisisya undu masukulu mosete matambya ma kuikiithya myamulo ila inenganitwe ni muvia wa uima wa ene nthi niyaatiwa kumana na uwau wa ikua ya Corona, ivindani yii amanyiwa mambiisya kusyokethya masukulu.
Magoha easya masukulu maingi nimekwithiwa maithukuma me muamba na isese sya uiiti, nikana vaumila thina ukathinikiwa kwa Mituki.
O na uu wiovo, niwakania atongoi ma masukulu maikatate kukuwa amanyiwa kumana na thii wa Fees.
Ingi Magoha niwakulya ndambuka mbingi ivetangwe masukulu,Vala wakania masukulu ma andu ene, kana vai mumanyiwa wailite kunyamawa kana kuvathulwa nundu wa kwithiwa ataneesoma kila kisomo kya Mitandao yila amanyiwa mei Misyi
Kwi Umunthi amanyiwa ma kilasi kya Grade 4, Class 8 na Form 4 niwo meikwatiwa kwambiisya kusyokethya masukulu.
Kiu ni itina wa masukulu kwithiwa mavingiwe myai 6 mivitu kuma mwaiini wa 3 mwakani uu, kumana na kisomo kuvingiiswa ni kumbuka kwa uwau wa ikua ya Corona.

translation:
Magoha yesterday was informed about the opening of Kenyan schools.
The CS expressed his sadness over the children in Tongoi and other schools, and the report he received regarding the challenges and difficulties they face, as one way of preparing the students to be able to learn.
The Minister of Education Professor George Magoha, expressed his sadness while visiting Olympic Primary School which is in Kibera near Nairobi County, said that schools should open and continue learning but be separated by the Ministry of Health so that they can comply with the protocols of preventing the spread of Corona, this information was given to encourage the reopening of schools.
Magoha said many schools have been prepared with water and soap and other necessities, adding that students will be able to prepare for learning.
And also, he denied reports that schools were delaying opening due to fees.
Magoha further stated that many challenges have been addressed in schools, but denied that some schools lack adequate facilities to prevent them from being infected or expelled due to failing to study every subject through online platforms which has been reported in the media.
In addition, classes for Grade 4, Class 8 and Form 4 were identified as those who would be prioritized when reopening schools.
This is because school calendars need to be adjusted within six months starting from three years ago, because education has been disrupted by the spread of Corona.

translation:
The carcass of a buffalo in Masinga was found in Kyeteni forest
It took 3 days for 3 people to realize it was a sign of Kyeteni forest which is in Masinga county of Machakos due to the large number of buffaloes, it has been there for 3 days and it is said to be from a vehicle that collided two days ago causing it to appear.
The chief of Masinga location, Henry Nyilu, expressed his sadness over this incident while trying to understand the cause of death.
Two more days and others were also hit by a vehicle, a male person, he identified his car, and some animals have died in Kyeteni forest in Masinga for the fourth time.
Regarding the matter of the carcass, three days ago people noticed the death in the area near Masinga, affecting Itunduimuni but within Ikaatini location.

text:
We Ngai, kwĩsĩla vala ve Mũathime Mbikĩla Malia ũte thavu nongi, nĩwamunengie muthembi waku Mũtheu Josemaria mumo ũtatalĩka, wamũnyuva atwĩke mũthũkũmi waku mũĩkĩi wawo wa kwambĩlĩĩlya Opus Dei, ĩla nĩ nzĩa ya kũkwata ũtheu kwĩsĩla mawĩa maitũ ma kĩla mũthenya na kwĩanĩĩsya mawĩa maitũ ma Mũkĩlisto. Nenge nyie onakwa kũmanya ũndũ nĩtonya kũvĩndũa maũndũ na mwĩkalĩle wakwa wa kĩla mũthenya na maũndũ oonthe ma thayũ wakwa matuĩke nĩmo mwanya wakwa wa wendo waku na kũtethya kanisa yaku ntheu, Asa Mũtheu na andũ oonthe, kwa ũtanu na wĩnyivyo, ngĩmulĩka nzĩa syonthe sya vaa nthĩ na mũĩkĩĩo na wendo. Kwa mboya sya Mũtheu Josemaria nĩngũũkulya ũmbĩanĩsye vata ũla ngũete mbee waku ...(vaa yu weta vata waku ũla wĩnawo) Amen.
Asa Waitu , Ngethi Malia, Ũkumyo kwa Asa.
license: ODC-By-1.0 (dataset); source text subject to Common Crawl Terms of Use
translation:
We God, accepting the prayer of Blessed Maria Julia who showed us the path, we commend ourselves to the intercession of Saint Josemaria, always steadfast, who introduced us to the faithful children of his founding work, Opus Dei, so that it may be a means of finding God in our ordinary lives and sanctifying our lives as Christians. May you grant us the grace to understand the mysteries and to live them daily and all the things that touch us, so that it may be a way of love and service to your Church, Saint Josemaria and all people, through unity and harmony, I offer all my works, thoughts and affections with love. Through the merits of Saint Josemaria, I humbly beg you to accept this offering which I present to you...(may you receive this offering which is unworthy) Amen.
Our Father, Hail Mary, Glory to the Father.

text:
Andu atano nimatiiwe ni thayu, mevo aka eli itina wa kunywa nzovi kuya Isiolo.
Andu angi kenda me sivitalini munene wa Isiolo maikwata uiiti vala maovisaa ma utheu vamwe na maovisaa ma volisi maendeeye kuthuima kiko kii.
Ovisaa muungamii wa kaunti isu Peter Ngechu easya kana mundumuka ula utanamba kumanyika anakuiye uki usu ula wina isyitwa' smart vodka' kuma sokoni wa Lodukae nginya sokoni wa Kipsing vala ala manathooeswe manaambiiye kukaya thina wa metho mbee wa mautanu moo kusenzya kikw'u.
Gavana wa isiolo Abdi Guyo niwumisye mwamulo wa nzyima mbai ya nzovi iasu na athoosya mayo kitai kiu kitanaalula.
license: ODC-By-1.0 (dataset); source text subject to Common Crawl Terms of Use
translation:
Five people were killed in an accident, some reportedly while drinking alcohol on their way to Isiolo.
Other people went to Isiolo Level 5 Hospital where they received treatment for various injuries and police investigations are ongoing to establish what happened.
The county government spokesperson Peter Ngechu said yesterday that he was saddened by the incident and condoled with the families and asked people to stop consuming 'smart vodka' in Lodukae market and Kipsing market because it has caused problems for them and five people have been injured.
Isiolo Governor Abdi Guyo has declared three days of mourning due to the tragedy and postponed his planned trip.

translation:
The residents of Athiriver county in Masaku have been troubled by thieves who steal things one by one, sometimes taking a child with them, and they roam around in three houses near Athiriver Kavindani, causing trouble and making noise.
These people are said to be led by the son of the chief of Athiriver township location, Martin Ngomo, who sends his children to steal, saying that if someone catches them, they will fight back with weapons and be assisted by their mother, and those who witness the thefts are threatened by the residents of Volosi police station, who destroy the homes of those who report them, specifically the home of Kusuvia's family in Suvitali village near Machakos Level 5 hospital, and they are warned not to speak.

text:
26TH July 2022
Muthauki kisinga cr7 eikwatiwa kukomana na manager wa kilavu kila uthaukiaa kya man united, Erik ten Hang vala mekwithiwa na uneenania yiulu wa muthauki uu na mivango ila winayo nthini wa kilavu kii. Ona uu wiovo, mauvoo kuma kiwanzani meweta kana muthauki uu no uendeeye kuthingiliila kana nomuvaka aume kilavuni kii athamiiye kilavu kingi kwondu wa kuthauka masindanoni ma uefa. Ronaldo ndekwenda kuthauka Europa leaque indi kilavu kii kya man united kiweta kana muthauki uu ndatonya kuthi vandu na maina muvango wa kumuthoosya, na kethwa nukwenda kutia kilavu kii aile kunenganwe kwa nzia ya mukovo na itina aisyokethya aminukilye kandalasi yake ila waile kumina mwakani ukite.

translation:
July 26th, 2022
Muthauki is reportedly being pressured to meet with Manchester United's manager, Erik ten Hag, who is said to be concerned about the player's future and his impact on the team's performance. It is understood that Muthauki may leave the club either on loan or permanently, and there is speculation that he could join another club competing in the Champions League. Ronaldo is also considering leaving for the Europa League with Manchester United if he does not get enough playing time, and it is believed that he is willing to take a pay cut to force a move, and has been looking at options through his agent but hasn't found a suitable offer yet.

text:
Munini wa president Dr William Samoei Ruto niweetya enenthi uekeo kukonya uneeni wa Senator wa kaunti ya Meru Mithika Linturi ula unaumisye umbanoni ula unaatwaiwe kuya Eldoret muthyani wa kyumwa.
Aineenea kuya kauntini ya Bomet,Ruto ona ou wiovo niwakulya nthu syake sya kiuteti syeke kuuniiya ngu ndeto isu aikulya mutwaiisya wa makwani ma silikali DPP Noordin Haji na Inspekta General wa volisi Hillary Mutyambai kwika ukunikiliyiulu wa ndeto isu.
Linturi anekiiwe mbini iyoo eo Eldoret na vala unathaamiiswe musyini munene wa Ilovi kukulwa maukulyo.
Linturi ethiingiliila kana uneeni wake ndunaathimite undu ualyulilwe vala Ruto nake waweta Linturi niwitisye uekeo na ndaile kuvinyiiwa na akulya uvyu wa miyao uteme ngali syonthe uteekweekea ngali imwe.
license: ODC-By-1.0 (dataset); source text subject to Common Crawl Terms of Use
translation:
The president Dr William Samoei Ruto's bodyguard is investigating the case concerning the arrest of Meru County Senator Mithika Linturi which has caused a stir and is said to be heading to Eldoret tomorrow morning.
It has spread to Bomet County, Ruto says he knows they are looking at his issues regarding the upcoming cases against Director of Public Prosecutions Noordin Haji and Inspector General of Police Hillary Mutyambai regarding the upcoming cases.
Linturi is being held in a cell in Eldoret and will likely be arraigned in a large court in Ilovi to answer charges.
Linturi denies that his arrest is politically motivated and claims that Ruto and Linturi have been targeted because of speaking the truth about the youth's problems which are always ignored.

translation:
The incident happened when a vehicle belonging to TOT was speeding along the road; the driver and 15 passengers were injured during an accident at River Itare which has been swept away by floods.
Those who sustained injuries have been admitted to Kapsowar hospital and are receiving treatment. The county commissioner of Marakwet East sub-county Simon Osumba said police officers have been dispatched to the scene to investigate the matter.

Andu ngili umwe 1,211 Umunthi nimo maikiithwa kukwatwa ni uwau wa Corona.
Kiu ni kumana na ithimo sya andu 9,304 ala mathimwa uwau wa corona ungu wa masaa 24 mavituka.
Nthini wa kaunti ya Ilovi, umunthi vakwatikana andu 410 Mena uwau wa Corona,Mombasa 102, Nakuru 40, Masaku 25, kajiado 21 naa Makueni mundu umwe.
Asu ma kuma kauntini ya Masaku, sub kauntini ya Athiriver vakwatikana andu 13,Masaku town 7,kangundo 2, Kalama, kathiiani na Matungulu kila vamwe mundu umwe.
Kuatiania na report ila yatumiwa mivia ya Unyaiikya wa mauvoo, andu 368 nimo mamina kuvutiwa kuma sivitalini syi kivathukanio, mamina kuvoa vyu uwau wa Corona.
Ona uu wiovo,Andu 17 nimaikiithwa kutiwa ni thayu kumana na uwau wa Corona.
Ikw'u isu syavikya andu ngili 1,366 ala maminite kutiwa ni thayu kumana na uwau wa Corona, kuma yila wavikie vaa Kenya.
Kaunti komishiner wa kaunti ya Kitui John Ondego, niwakulya ene nthi ma Kitui maendeeye na kuatiiya miao ila yalanitwe ni silikali kuukitana na uwau wa Corona.

translation:
One person died, 1,211 others were confirmed infected with the Coronavirus.
The total number of infections reached 9,304 while 24 hours ago there were new cases reported.
In Machakos County, 410 people were found infected with the Coronavirus, Mombasa 102, Nakuru 40, Masaku 25, Kajiado 21 and Makueni one person.
Today in Machakos county, in Athiriver sub-county 13 people were found infected, Masaku town 7, Kangundo 2, Kalama, Kathiani and Matungulu each one person.
According to the report sent through the Ministry of Health, 368 people have been admitted to various hospitals, most of them suffering from the Coronavirus.
However, today 17 people are said to have recovered from the Coronavirus.
So far, a total of 1,366 people have recovered from the Coronavirus across Kenya.
Kitui County Commissioner John Ondego has stated that Kitui county is progressing well and cooperating with the government in combating the Coronavirus.
